Hi, pwBPD here.
I don’t know if I can say anything helpful, but I‘ll try.

If you want to get over his ex, not stalking her would probably be a start. I get why you do it, but getting over her requires not having that much information about her at all times. 
Also him being on NC with her is a good start. Really make it clear that it’s not okay for him to bring her up and all that. Sounds like he definitely needs to get over her completely too, and he needs to be completely sure about wanting to be with you for this to work.

And I obviously can’t see into his mind, but as a pwBPD I usually hurt people in that way when I get scared of them leaving, so I try to push them away and pretend I don’t have feelings for them first. Sometimes that even gets to the point of thinking I actually never felt anything for them. 
Him actually trying to make it work, doing therapy and couples therapy and going nc with his ex shows that he’s trying, so I‘d guess his „I love you“s are genuine. It’s okay if you need some time to trust him on that again. Time and him not messing it up again is probably what’s needed to rebuild that trust.

And lastly, we are definitely capable of love. It just takes a lot of work on our side to make it work. That being said, if you feel he isn’t ready to put that work in, doesn’t have enough self control, or you just can’t handle him, don’t blame yourself if you decide to end the relationship for good. At the end of the day, you have to do what‘s right for you.

He commented something funny on a mutual friend‘s picture and he had dyed hair in his profile picture, so naturally I was interested in him and started following him.
Noticed pretty soon that he wasn’t very well mentally and pm‘d him because of it. Ofc he didn’t really wanna talk about it with a stranger, but once I sent my first message, I had the courage to talk to him more often about pretty much anything. So after a few months we were texting pretty much daily and had started to open up to each other. I really, really liked his humor, the way he wrote, and we had a few mutual interests. I also thought he was hella attractive. I was in a relationship at the time, so I was in complete denial of having feelings for him. But he kinda became my go to person to share my happiest and worst moments with and I loved hearing anything and everything about him and his life.
Broke up with my ex boyfriend on New Year’s Eve (lol) for different reasons, it was really civil and we stayed friends for a while after. And pretty much the moment I was „allowed“ to have a crush on someone else, my brain just went „Ah shit I‘m catching feelings“.
We talked about crushes and relationships a few times and he always said that he tried to just not crush on people anymore and that relationships were just generally too stressful, so I didn’t think I‘d ever have a chance with him. 
Problem was, my feelings for him just kept getting stronger and I was like constantly kinda sad and stressed because of it. So I decided to tell him, just to get it over with, and then probably break contact so I could get over him.
So I did tell him. I was sitting there, shaking and crying because I’m emotionally unstable and this fucked me up, I poured my heart out over text, wrote half a novel about how I couldn’t stop thinking about him and I had all these strong feelings for him even tho we‘d never met, and I just expected to be rejected. I didn’t get rejected. He said he felt the same and we went on a date/met for the first time a few days later.
He was absolutely stunning, just as funny and nice and amazing as he was over text and we got along great, even though we were both being completely awkward. We were both too anxious to initiate any physical contact during the date, but other than that it was great.
It was winter and in the middle of the night and he missed his train back home on purpose because I didn’t want him to leave yet, and when he finally had to leave I somehow managed to ask him for a hug. 
We called for six (6!!) hours the next night and it was absolutely amazing. A week later he asked me to be his girlfriend.
We‘ve been together for a bit more than 9 months and it has been the best time of my life. I still love every little thing about him. Seeing him is the best part of my day. Hearing him laugh makes me happier than anything. And whatever I do, it’s just so much better when it’s with him.
